687d0a309107a80e07401e5d.name: IV-Imbalance Credit Spread Overnight
687d0a309107a80e07401e5d.summary: IV-Imbalance is a NIFTY overnight credit-spread strategy that reads an IV-skew signal and sells whichever side (calls or puts) looks better positioned, holding ~15 hours from a ~3 PM entry to next-morning exit. It wins 58.2% of its 194 trades with a 1.77 profit factor (avg win +58.1 pts vs avg loss -45.8 pts, ~13 trades/month), and its edge is strongest in trending markets with calm-to-moderate realized vol, weakest when realized vol spikes.
687d0a309107a80e07401e5d.what_it_trades: ~400-pt-wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (2-leg, no iron condors), split 57.2% CE / 42.8% PE, avg entry credit ~93.3 pts; side is chosen dynamically from an IV-imbalance/skew signal rather than fixed to one direction.
687d0a309107a80e07401e5d.style_evidence: By direction, profit is strongest away from sideways: bear averages +28.41 pts (70.45% win, 44 trades) and bull +19.78 pts (57.58% win, 33 trades), versus sideways at just +8.16 pts (53.85% win, 117 trades) — a directional/momentum signature. But by realized vol the pattern flips to a premium-selling profile: low-vol averages +17.07 pts (59.34% win, 91 trades) and normal-vol +18.41 pts (68.09% win, 47 trades), while high-vol collapses to +7.83 pts (48.21% win, 56 trades). Directional profit concentration plus vol-averse edge is a hybrid pattern, hence 'mixed' rather than a pure style.
687d0a309107a80e07401e5d.expiry: Likely weekly NIFTY options (inferred) — the short overnight hold and 400-pt strike width are typical of weekly index credit spreads; one_liner/style_label don't state expiry explicitly.
687d0a309107a80e07401e5d.hold: Overnight, per style_label: enters ~3 PM and exits the next morning (~15h hold) — a single-night, date-level position, not an intraday scalp.
687d0a309107a80e07401e5d.makes_money_when: Best: bear-trending sessions (avg +28.41 pts, 70.45% win over 44 trades) and, on the vol axis, normal realized vol (avg +18.41 pts, 68.09% win over 47 trades). Worst: high realized-vol sessions (avg +7.83 pts, 48.21% win over 56 trades) and, on the direction axis, sideways markets (avg +8.16 pts, 53.85% win over 117 trades, its largest regime bucket).
687d0a309107a80e07401e5d.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data is available in this file. As a realized-vol proxy (not implied vol): the strategy performs best in low (avg +17.07 pts, 59.34% win, 91 trades) and normal (avg +18.41 pts, 68.09% win, 47 trades) realized-vol regimes, but degrades sharply in high realized vol (avg +7.83 pts, 48.21% win, 56 trades) — consistent with a ~400-pt credit spread losing edge when realized moves expand.

68596cd26aa2cba24bbb67da.name: Zen Credit Spread Overnight
68596cd26aa2cba24bbb67da.summary: Zen Credit Spread Overnight sells ~400-pt-wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (53% PE / 47% CE), entering around 3 PM and holding overnight to the next morning across 213 trades (56.3% win rate, 1.64 profit factor). It performs best on trending days — bull (+18.44 pts) and bear (+19.13 pts) sessions roughly double the sideways-day average (+7.90 pts) — while realized-vol impact is mixed, with the best results on normal-vol days rather than a clean low-or-high split.
68596cd26aa2cba24bbb67da.what_it_trades: ~400-pt-wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (2-leg), roughly 53% PE / 47% CE, avg entry credit ~88.2 pts, 0% iron condors.
68596cd26aa2cba24bbb67da.style_evidence: Directional regimes clearly outperform sideways (bull +18.44 pts/35 trades, bear +19.13 pts/50 trades vs sideways +7.90 pts/128 trades), which reads as a directional edge. But realized-vol regimes don't confirm a clean momentum or mean-reversion pattern: normal-vol is best at +17.80 pts (53 trades, 67.9% win), low-vol is worst at +8.63 pts (104 trades, 51.9% win), and high-vol sits in between at +13.80 pts (56 trades, 53.6% win). Combined with a fairly balanced 47/53 CE/PE side mix and 0% iron-condor structure, the two dimensions point different directions, so it's classified mixed rather than a single clean style.
68596cd26aa2cba24bbb67da.expiry: Likely weekly NIFTY options (inferred) — the overnight-to-next-morning hold and 400-pt spread width fit a near-dated weekly structure, though no expiry field exists in the data.
68596cd26aa2cba24bbb67da.hold: Overnight — enters around 3 PM and exits the next morning (~15h hold), per style_label. Data is date-level only, so no finer intraday timing is available.
68596cd26aa2cba24bbb67da.makes_money_when: Best on trending days: bear moves average +19.13 pts (50 trades, 58.0% win) and bull moves +18.44 pts (35 trades, 57.1% win), both roughly 2.3-2.4x the sideways-day average of +7.90 pts (128 trades, 55.5% win). By realized vol, normal-vol days are strongest at +17.80 pts (53 trades, 67.9% win); low-vol days are weakest at +8.63 pts (104 trades, 51.9% win), with high-vol days in between at +13.80 pts (56 trades, 53.6% win).
68596cd26aa2cba24bbb67da.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists. Using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol): normal-vol days perform best (+17.80 pts avg, 53 trades, 67.9% win), low-vol days perform worst (+8.63 pts avg, 104 trades, 51.9% win), and high-vol days sit in between (+13.80 pts avg, 56 trades, 53.6% win) — no clean monotonic relationship with realized vol.

692811d5b3dc6cfbe85053a2.name: Delta-Rotation Credit Spread Expiry
692811d5b3dc6cfbe85053a2.summary: Delta-Rotation Expiry runs 400-pt-wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (62% call side, 38% put side, no iron condors) held through weekly expiry, rotating delta exposure across the week per its own description. Over 92 trades it wins 56.5% of the time with a 1.62 profit factor (avg win +69.5 pts vs avg loss -55.7 pts), but the edge doesn't split cleanly by regime — it earns most in bull moves (+28.95 avg pts) and high realized vol (+18.47 avg pts), while normal-vol and bear conditions are weakest (+9.46 and +12.33 avg pts). Best read as a moderate, regime-mixed credit-spread strategy rather than a pure mean-reversion or momentum play.
692811d5b3dc6cfbe85053a2.what_it_trades: ~400-pt wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (2-leg), 62% call side / 38% put side, avg entry credit ~108.4 pts, 0% iron condors, ~10.2 trades/month.
692811d5b3dc6cfbe85053a2.style_evidence: Best avg_pts is in the bull regime at +28.95 (14 trades, 57.1% win) vs sideways +12.79 (45 trades, 62.2% win) and bear +12.33 (33 trades, 48.5% win) — a bull tilt, not the sideways-dominant pattern of a clean premium seller. By realized vol, high-vol avg +18.47 (49 trades, 55.1% win) beats low-vol +13.92 (17 trades, 64.7% win), with normal-vol worst at +9.46 (26 trades, 53.9% win) — no clean low-vol signature either, so neither the mean-revert nor the momentum profile fits cleanly.
692811d5b3dc6cfbe85053a2.expiry: Weekly NIFTY expiry (inferred from style_label 'Weekly expiry — hold spread through expiry week' and one_liner 'Rotates delta exposure through the week').
692811d5b3dc6cfbe85053a2.hold: Held through expiry week, per style_label ('Weekly expiry — hold spread through expiry week'). Data is date-level only, so no specific intraday hour count can be stated beyond that.
692811d5b3dc6cfbe85053a2.makes_money_when: Best regime: bull, avg +28.95 pts/trade (14 trades, 57.1% win). Worst directional regime: bear, avg +12.33 pts/trade (33 trades, 48.5% win — its weakest win rate). By vol: best is high-vol, avg +18.47 pts (49 trades, 55.1% win); worst is normal-vol, avg +9.46 pts (26 trades, 53.9% win). All buckets stay net positive, but the size of the edge swings a lot across regimes.
692811d5b3dc6cfbe85053a2.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data available. As a realized-vol proxy: high-realized-vol trades average +18.47 pts (49 trades, 55.1% win, the best avg_pts bucket), low-vol trades average +13.92 pts (17 trades, 64.7% win, the best win-rate bucket), and normal-vol trades are weakest at +9.46 pts (26 trades, 53.9% win). It holds up in high realized vol rather than fading, unlike a strategy that depends on vol staying low.

687d08f09107a80e07401e57.name: Curvature Credit Spread Overnight
687d08f09107a80e07401e57.summary: Curvature sells NIFTY call (CE) credit spreads only, holding overnight from ~3 PM to next morning. Across 187 trades it wins 54.5% of the time with a 1.51 profit factor, but the edge is concentrated: it does best when the market chops sideways in a low-realized-vol regime, and weakens sharply when realized vol picks up.
687d08f09107a80e07401e57.what_it_trades: ~400-pt NIFTY call (CE) credit spreads, 100% CE side (never sells puts), 2-leg vertical structure, avg entry credit ~101 pts, ~12.5 trades/month.
687d08f09107a80e07401e57.style_evidence: Sideways avg +11.55 pts/trade (60.0% win, best of the 3 directional buckets) and low-vol avg +17.51 pts/trade (61.45% win, best of the 3 vol buckets) vs high-vol avg +6.11 pts/trade (42.59% win, worst) and normal-vol avg +3.16 pts/trade (lowest avg_pts) — profit concentrates in calm, range-bound conditions rather than in strong trends or high-vol regimes, the signature of a premium-selling approach.
687d08f09107a80e07401e57.expiry: Weekly NIFTY options (inferred) — the overnight hold and 400-pt strike width point to a short-dated weekly-expiry structure rather than monthly.
687d08f09107a80e07401e57.hold: Overnight only, per style_label: enters ~3 PM and exits the next morning (~15h hold), never carried across multiple sessions.
687d08f09107a80e07401e57.makes_money_when: Best in sideways markets (avg +11.55 pts, 60.0% win) and low realized-vol regimes (avg +17.51 pts, 61.45% win). Worst in high realized-vol conditions (avg +6.11 pts, only 42.59% win) and bull trends (45.45% win, the lowest of the three directional buckets).
687d08f09107a80e07401e57.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data is available; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol), the strategy is strongest in low realized vol (avg +17.51 pts, 61.45% win) and progressively weaker as realized vol rises — normal vol avg +3.16 pts (56.0% win), high vol avg +6.11 pts but only 42.59% win, its weakest win rate of any bucket.

698075eaf867bf12b20442e5.name: Ratio-Fluxer Credit Spread Expiry
698075eaf867bf12b20442e5.summary: Ratio-Fluxer sells NIFTY vertical credit spreads, mostly on the call side, and holds them through expiry week rather than closing early. Across a small 13-trade sample it wins 84.6% of the time with a 9.98 profit factor, but the edge is clearly a low-volatility/range-bound one: it does best when the market sits sideways in calm conditions and gives back the most ground when realized volatility picks up.
698075eaf867bf12b20442e5.what_it_trades: ~400-pt-wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (avg entry credit 118.4 pts), 76.9% call (CE) side vs 23.1% put (PE) side, no iron condors (0%)
698075eaf867bf12b20442e5.style_evidence: Best avg_pts in sideways markets (+90.85, 100% WR, 4 trades) and low realized vol (+106.93, 100% WR, 3 trades); avg_pts shrinks and win rate degrades most as realized vol rises to high (+33.2 avg, win rate down to 66.67%, 6 trades) — profit concentrated in calm/sideways conditions, not directional moves.
698075eaf867bf12b20442e5.hold: Held through expiry week rather than closed early — consistent with style_label 'Weekly expiry — hold spread through expiry week'; date-level data only, no intraday hold time available.
698075eaf867bf12b20442e5.makes_money_when: Best: sideways markets (+90.85 avg pts, 100% WR, 4 trades) paired with low realized vol (+106.93 avg pts, 100% WR, 3 trades). Weakest by avg_pts: bullish markets (+49.92 avg pts, 100% WR, only 2 trades) post the lowest average points of the three directional buckets; bearish markets (+51.7 avg pts, 71.43% WR, 7 trades) score slightly higher on avg_pts but show the steepest win-rate degradation on a larger sample. High realized vol is unambiguously the weakest vol regime (+33.2 avg pts, 66.67% WR, 6 trades). All buckets remain net positive, but the edge compresses outside sideways/low-vol conditions.
698075eaf867bf12b20442e5.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol), performance steps down as realized vol rises: low vol +106.93 avg pts (100% WR, 3 trades) > normal vol +76.29 avg pts (100% WR, 4 trades) > high vol +33.2 avg pts (66.67% WR, 6 trades).

68c9b755c7ed8fff5c5de9af.name: Damper Credit Spread
68c9b755c7ed8fff5c5de9af.summary: Damper is the only intraday credit-spread algo in the set -- it opens and closes ~400-pt NIFTY vertical spreads within the same session instead of carrying overnight risk. It wins 60.7% of 270 trades (profit factor 1.48, avg win +31.4 pts vs avg loss -32.8 pts) at a modest ~21 trades/month pace. It's profitable in all three directional regimes (no losing regime): it trades most often in sideways/range days (163 of 270, 60%) where per-trade points are lowest (+3.84 pts, 59.5% WR), while its best per-trade edge shows up on bull days (+12.38 pts, 68.0% WR, 50 trades).
68c9b755c7ed8fff5c5de9af.what_it_trades: ~400-point NIFTY vertical credit spreads (2-leg), 53% PE side / 47% CE side, no iron condors (0%), entered and exited intraday.
68c9b755c7ed8fff5c5de9af.style_evidence: Trade volume is concentrated in sideways/range days (163 of 270 trades, 60%) -- the regime you'd expect a credit spread to lean on for time decay -- yet those trades post the lowest average points (+3.84 pts, 59.5% WR) of the three regimes. Bull days are the clear standout (+12.38 pts, 68.0% WR, 50 trades); bear days are middling on points but weakest on win rate (+7.58 pts, 57.9% WR, 57 trades). Every regime is net positive, so this doesn't cleanly fit either a trend-following or a mean-reversion story -- it's a mixed profile with a bullish tilt.
68c9b755c7ed8fff5c5de9af.expiry: NIFTY weekly options, closed same-day rather than held to expiry (inferred from underlying + intraday style_label; no explicit expiry field in data).
68c9b755c7ed8fff5c5de9af.hold: Intraday only — opened and closed within the same trading session (style_label: "Intraday — enter and exit same trading session"), never carried overnight; one_liner notes ~35-pt average wins here vs ~60-pt wins on this desk's overnight algos.
68c9b755c7ed8fff5c5de9af.makes_money_when: Best: bull-direction days, avg +12.38 pts at 68.0% win rate (50 trades). Worst: sideways days, avg +3.84 pts at 59.5% win rate (163 trades) — still positive but the weakest bucket by a wide margin. On the vol axis, normal realized-vol is best (avg +8.88 pts, 62.9% WR, 62 trades) and high realized-vol is weakest by win rate (56.8% WR on 81 trades, though avg pts +5.79).
68c9b755c7ed8fff5c5de9af.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; this uses regime.vol as a realized-vol proxy, not implied vol. Performance is fairly flat across buckets: normal realized-vol avg +8.88 pts (62.9% WR, 62 trades), low realized-vol avg +5.18 pts (62.2% WR, 127 trades), high realized-vol avg +5.79 pts but the lowest win rate at 56.8% (81 trades) — no strong edge from elevated realized volatility despite this being a premium-collecting spread.

69c37974013fb47e43ebb92d.name: Prudent 30%SL FixedRR 1:3
69c37974013fb47e43ebb92d.summary: Prudent 30%SL FixedRR 1:3 buys far-OTM NIFTY options (51.1% CE / 48.9% PE) and exits on a fixed 1:3 reward:risk target or a 30% stop-loss. Across 45 trades it wins only 40% of the time but a 39.7-pt average win against a 15.7-pt average loss gives it a 1.69 profit factor. It needs a directional push or a vol spike to pay off and bleeds small losses in quiet, range-bound markets.
69c37974013fb47e43ebb92d.what_it_trades: ~7 trades/month of far-OTM NIFTY option buys (near-even CE/PE split), each run on a fixed 1:3 reward:risk exit with a 30% stop-loss.
69c37974013fb47e43ebb92d.style_evidence: Profit concentrates in directional/high-vol regimes: bull avg +19.04 pts (46.67% win, 15 trades) and high-vol avg +18.1 pts (50% win, 22 trades), vs losses in flat/quiet regimes: sideways avg -3.51 pts (26.67% win, 15 trades) and low-vol avg -10.06 pts (30% win, 10 trades) — a long-premium payoff shape that needs movement to work.
69c37974013fb47e43ebb92d.expiry: Likely NIFTY weekly expiries, inferred from the far-OTM (OTM_far) moneyness and ~7 trades/month cadence (inferred).
69c37974013fb47e43ebb92d.hold: Fixed_rr exit label means it closes as soon as the 1:3 reward:risk target or 30% stop-loss is hit, not necessarily held to expiry. Data is date-level only, so no specific intraday hold duration can be stated.
69c37974013fb47e43ebb92d.makes_money_when: Best regimes: bull (avg +19.04 pts, 46.67% win, 15 trades) and high realized-vol (avg +18.1 pts, 50% win, 22 trades). Worst regimes: sideways (avg -3.51 pts, 26.67% win, 15 trades) and low realized-vol (avg -10.06 pts, 30% win, 10 trades).
69c37974013fb47e43ebb92d.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol), the strategy is strongly vol-positive: high-vol avg +18.1 pts (50% win, 22 trades) vs normal-vol avg -0.42 pts (30.77% win, 13 trades) and low-vol avg -10.06 pts (30% win, 10 trades) — it needs realized movement, not calm markets, to profit.

68b09f187df2142799a9fa82.name: Convex Credit Spread Overnight
68b09f187df2142799a9fa82.summary: Convex Credit Spread Overnight sells ~400-pt NIFTY vertical credit spreads, entering around 3 PM and holding overnight to the next morning, split roughly 55% PE / 45% CE with zero iron condors. Across 154 trades it wins 51.9% of the time with a 1.41 profit factor (avg win 62.5 pts vs avg loss -47.9 pts), but it carries the deepest max drawdown in its algo family (576 pts) and is explicitly flagged as inferior to its siblings. It performs best on trending (bull or bear) days rather than range-bound ones, with no clean realized-vol edge.
68b09f187df2142799a9fa82.what_it_trades: ~400-pt NIFTY vertical credit spreads (2-leg, 0% iron condor), 55% PE-side / 45% CE-side, opened ~3 PM and carried overnight to next morning.
68b09f187df2142799a9fa82.style_evidence: Sideways days are its weakest: +5.37 avg pts (89 trades, 52.8% WR) vs bull +12.95 avg pts (31 trades, 48.4% WR) and bear +17.12 avg pts (34 trades, 52.9% WR) - profit is concentrated in directional/trending days, not range-bound ones, so despite being a credit-spread structure it behaves more like a directional play than a theta-harvest/mean-revert one.
68b09f187df2142799a9fa82.expiry: Weekly NIFTY expiries (inferred from ~11.8 trades/month cadence and the 400-pt vertical-spread structure, consistent with weekly options turnover)
68b09f187df2142799a9fa82.hold: Overnight hold - opened around 3 PM and closed the next morning, per style_label (~15h hold).
68b09f187df2142799a9fa82.makes_money_when: Best: bear regime (+17.12 avg pts, 52.9% WR, 34 trades) and normal realized-vol regime (+11.76 avg pts, 57.5% WR, 40 trades). Worst: sideways regime (+5.37 avg pts, lowest of the three direction buckets, 89 trades) and high realized-vol regime (+8.68 avg pts with win rate dropping to 47.1%, 51 trades).
68b09f187df2142799a9fa82.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol): best in normal realized vol (+11.76 pts, 57.5% WR, 40 trades), close to flat in low vol (+8.71 pts, 52.4% WR, 63 trades), and weakest in high vol where avg pts is similar (+8.68) but win rate falls to 47.1% (51 trades) - no strong directional vol edge, just a win-rate dip under high realized vol.

683c633ced2623775f750344.name: SkewHunter TSL
683c633ced2623775f750344.summary: SkewHunter TSL is a NIFTY option-buying strategy (ITM strikes, near 50/50 CE/PE split) that enters on a skew signal and exits via a trailing stop-loss, trading about once a day. It only clears its 46.2-avg-win/-24.0-avg-loss edge (1.13 profit factor, 36.9% win rate over 390 trades) when realized volatility is high, so it works best in fast, bullish, high-vol NIFTY moves and struggles in quiet, low-vol markets.
683c633ced2623775f750344.what_it_trades: ~1 trade/day (24.2/month) in NIFTY ITM options, near-balanced CE/PE (51.5%/48.5%), entered on a proprietary skew signal and exited on a trailing stop-loss rather than a fixed target.
683c633ced2623775f750344.style_evidence: Profit is concentrated in high realized-vol days (avg +8.94 pts, 41.84% win, 98 trades) versus low-vol (-0.55 pts, 34.12% win, 170 trades) and roughly flat normal-vol (-0.03 pts, 122 trades) days -- it needs movement to pay off, not quiet range. Direction-wise, bull days are the strongest (avg +3.02 pts, 41.1% win, 73 trades) versus sideways (+1.75 pts) and bear (+1.78 pts). Combined with the ob_strategy tags trend_label='trend_following' and market_fit='bull_day_alpha', this is directional/momentum behavior, not premium-selling.
683c633ced2623775f750344.expiry: Likely short-dated NIFTY options (weekly-style), given ~1 trade/day entry cadence and ITM moneyness (inferred).
683c633ced2623775f750344.hold: Exits are trailing-stop-loss driven (style_label 'trailing_sl'), not held to a fixed expiry or target -- positions are cut once the trailing SL triggers. Data is date-level only, so no intraday hold duration can be stated.
683c633ced2623775f750344.makes_money_when: Best: high realized-vol days (avg +8.94 pts, 41.84% win, 98 trades), especially combined with bull moves (avg +3.02 pts, 41.1% win, 73 trades). Worst: low realized-vol/quiet days (avg -0.55 pts, 34.12% win, 170 trades), with normal-vol days also flat-to-losing (avg -0.03 pts, 36.89% win, 122 trades).
683c633ced2623775f750344.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol): the strategy loses money in low realized-vol conditions (avg -0.55 pts, 34.12% win, 170 trades), is roughly breakeven in normal vol (avg -0.03 pts, 36.89% win, 122 trades), and its entire edge comes from high realized-vol days (avg +8.94 pts, 41.84% win, 98 trades) -- a strategy that needs volatility to expand to work.

694bb7183bd0c2a598ba2c94.name: Theta-Harvest Credit Spread Expiry
694bb7183bd0c2a598ba2c94.summary: Theta-Harvest Credit Spread Expiry sells ~400-pt wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (53.1% PE, 46.9% CE, zero iron condors) for a rich ~111-pt average credit and holds through weekly expiry. It only wins 47.8% of its 113 trades but nets a 1.37 profit factor because average winners (+72.6 pts) run well past average losers (-48.4 pts). Despite being structured as a premium-selling spread, its edge actually shows up in bearish, high-realized-vol weeks rather than calm or sideways ones.
694bb7183bd0c2a598ba2c94.what_it_trades: ~400-pt wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (53% PE, 47% CE, no iron condors), sold for an average ~111-pt credit and carried through to weekly expiry (12.6 trades/month, 113 trades total).
694bb7183bd0c2a598ba2c94.style_evidence: No clean archetype fits. It isn't mean-reverting/premium-selling: it loses in calm markets (low realized-vol avg -0.8 pts, 19 trades, 42.1% WR) and needs volatility to pay off (high realized-vol avg +18.29 pts, 59 trades, 52.5% WR) - the opposite of a calm-market premium seller. It isn't clean trend-following/momentum either: bull trend has the lowest win rate of any bucket in the whole dataset (37.5%, 16 trades) despite a marginally positive avg (+5.22 pts), so it fails to capture the bullish side of trends. It isn't neutral/range: sideways is merely middling (avg +5.2 pts, 44.4% WR, 54 trades), not the best or worst bucket. The only real edge shows up specifically in bear trend (avg +16.36 pts, 55.8% WR, 43 trades) combined with high realized-vol (avg +18.29 pts, 52.5% WR, 59 trades) - a bear-and-volatility-skewed pattern that doesn't generalize into a single style, hence 'mixed.'
694bb7183bd0c2a598ba2c94.expiry: Weekly expiry (inferred from one_liner 'Holds to weekly expiry' and style_label 'Weekly expiry — hold spread through expiry week').
694bb7183bd0c2a598ba2c94.hold: Held through the full expiry week per style_label, not closed intraday or early in the cycle. Data is date-level only, so no intraday hold duration can be stated beyond this.
694bb7183bd0c2a598ba2c94.makes_money_when: Best: high realized-vol regime (avg +18.29 pts, 59 trades, 52.5% win rate) and bear trend (avg +16.36 pts, 43 trades, 55.8% win rate). Worst: low realized-vol regime (avg -0.8 pts, 19 trades, 42.1% win rate) and bull trend (avg +5.22 pts, 16 trades, 37.5% win rate — lowest win rate of any bucket).
694bb7183bd0c2a598ba2c94.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol), avg_pts rises from -0.8 (low-vol) to 0.11 (normal-vol) to +18.29 (high-vol) — the strategy needs elevated realized volatility to pay off, which cuts against its premium-selling structure.

685848b09edddcb829103b9b.name: Burst RR 1:2 (25% SL)
685848b09edddcb829103b9b.summary: Burst RR 1:2 is a NIFTY option-buying strategy that exits on a fixed 1:2 reward-to-risk ratio with a 25% stop-loss, trading mostly ITM contracts skewed 69.3% PE / 30.7% CE. It profits in trending markets (bull +4.19 avg pts, bear +1.68 avg pts) and on high realized-vol days (+1.69 avg pts), but loses money in sideways conditions (-1.44 avg pts), which make up its largest trade bucket (244 of 424). Overall edge is thin: 39.2% win rate and a profit factor of just 1.03 across 424 trades.
685848b09edddcb829103b9b.what_it_trades: ~1 trade/day (26.4/month) in NIFTY ITM options, 69.3% PE-side vs 30.7% CE-side, each sized to a fixed 1:2 reward:risk with a 25% stop-loss.
685848b09edddcb829103b9b.style_evidence: Worst regime is sideways at -1.44 avg pts (244 trades, 36.48% win) vs bull +4.19 avg pts (85 trades, 42.35% win) and bear +1.68 avg pts (95 trades, 43.16% win); high-vol avg +1.69 pts beats normal-vol -0.49 pts. Directional and vol-expansion days pay, range-bound days bleed — consistent with the file's own trend_following tag and bear_market market_fit.
685848b09edddcb829103b9b.expiry: Likely NIFTY weekly ITM options (inferred) — ITM strikes suit directional/delta exposure rather than a pure premium-decay play.
685848b09edddcb829103b9b.hold: Not stated beyond date-level trade records. style_label is 'fixed_rr' — the exit rule is a 1:2 reward:risk target with a 25% stop-loss, not a defined calendar hold, so intraday vs. overnight duration isn't in the data.
685848b09edddcb829103b9b.makes_money_when: Best: bull trends (+4.19 avg pts, 42.4% win, 85 trades) and high realized-vol days (+1.69 avg pts, 40.8% win, 98 trades). Worst: sideways/range markets (-1.44 avg pts, 36.5% win, 244 trades — the biggest bucket) and normal-vol days (-0.49 avg pts, 37.2% win).
685848b09edddcb829103b9b.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data available. As a realized-vol proxy (regime.vol buckets, not implied vol): high-vol days average +1.69 pts (40.82% win), low-vol days a flat +0.32 pts (39.59% win), and normal-vol days are the worst at -0.49 pts (37.21% win) — the strategy needs either calm drift or vol expansion, and struggles in middling/choppy conditions.

699c0256738c5d8c44dbb3c8.name: Savdhaan 35% SL
699c0256738c5d8c44dbb3c8.summary: Savdhaan 35% SL is a far-OTM NIFTY option-buying strategy (88.9% CE, 11.1% PE) that exits on a fixed 35% stop-loss rather than riding to expiry. Its edge is asymmetric payoff (avg win +73.6 pts vs avg loss -27.6 pts, profit factor 1.9) despite a sub-50% win rate (41.7% over 72 trades), and it needs a real directional move to pay off. It works best in bear markets and high realized-vol stretches, and bleeds small in bull and sideways conditions.
699c0256738c5d8c44dbb3c8.what_it_trades: ~Far-OTM NIFTY options, predominantly calls (88.9% CE / 11.1% PE), about 2 trades/week (9.9/month), each exited on a fixed 35% stop-loss.
699c0256738c5d8c44dbb3c8.style_evidence: Directional split: bear avg +31.85 pts (win 54.3%, 35 trades) vs bull avg -3.09 pts (win 25.0%, 12 trades) and sideways avg -1.17 pts (win 32.0%, 25 trades). Vol split: high-vol avg +24.56 pts (win 43.2%, 37 trades) vs normal-vol avg +4.23 pts (win 30.4%, 23 trades). Win/loss shape is also asymmetric (avg win +73.6 pts vs avg loss -27.6 pts) — a small-loss/big-win convexity profile typical of momentum option buying, not premium selling.
699c0256738c5d8c44dbb3c8.expiry: Not stated in the data; far-OTM NIFTY option buying with a fixed stop-loss usually runs on weekly or near-week NIFTY expiries (inferred).
699c0256738c5d8c44dbb3c8.hold: Exits are stop-loss driven (fixed 35% SL, per style_label 'fixed_sl' and the one-liner), not held to expiry by default; data is date-level only, so no specific holding-period duration beyond 'stopped out early or trailed a move' can be stated.
699c0256738c5d8c44dbb3c8.makes_money_when: Best regime: bear market, avg +31.85 pts, 54.3% win rate (35 trades). Worst regime: bull market, avg -3.09 pts, 25.0% win rate (12 trades) — sideways is also a loser at avg -1.17 pts (32.0% win rate, 25 trades). By volatility, high-vol is best at avg +24.56 pts (43.2% win, 37 trades); normal-vol is worst at avg +4.23 pts (30.4% win, 23 trades) despite low-vol having the highest win rate (58.3%, avg +3.53 pts, 12 trades).
699c0256738c5d8c44dbb3c8.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy, avg points scale up sharply with realized vol — low-vol +3.53 pts (58.3% win), normal-vol +4.23 pts (30.4% win), high-vol +24.56 pts (43.2% win). The strategy is a realized-vol proxy beneficiary: it needs bigger realized moves (bear + high-vol) to clear its stop-loss and pay off; it stagnates or loses in calm/normal conditions.

69afccbb5aeb6283f4dde564.name: Sookshma-Nazar 25% SL
69afccbb5aeb6283f4dde564.summary: Sookshma-Nazar 25% SL is an option-buying (not credit spread) system that buys ITM NIFTY options — 56.5% PE vs 43.5% CE — and exits on a fixed 25% stop loss, trading about 9.4 times a month. It's trend-following: it loses money in sideways markets and low/normal realized-vol conditions but pays off strongly in bear moves and high-vol regimes. Across 69 trades it wins only 39.1% of the time yet nets a 2.26 profit factor because average wins (57.9 pts) dwarf average losses (-16.5 pts).
69afccbb5aeb6283f4dde564.what_it_trades: ITM NIFTY options (mostly PE, 59.1% vs 40.9% CE per ob_strategy), bought outright and cut on a fixed 25% stop loss, ~9.4 trades/month (about 3/week).
69afccbb5aeb6283f4dde564.style_evidence: Profits concentrate in directional/high-vol regimes and evaporate in chop: bull avg +20.01pts (win 35.29%, 17 trades), bear avg +25.92pts (win 56.52%, 23 trades) vs sideways avg -2.17pts (win 27.59%, 29 trades); high-vol avg +35.21pts (win 51.85%, 27 trades) vs low-vol avg -0.42pts (win 35.71%, 14 trades) and normal-vol avg -2.54pts (win 28.57%, 28 trades). Also tagged trend_following/bear_market fit in ob_strategy.
69afccbb5aeb6283f4dde564.expiry: (inferred) likely weekly NIFTY options — trade frequency of ~3/week and a fixed-SL exit style point to short-dated weekly contracts rather than monthly run-to-expiry positions.
69afccbb5aeb6283f4dde564.hold: Exited on a fixed 25% stop loss (style_label: fixed_sl) rather than held to expiry — an actively stop-managed position. Data is date-level only, so no specific intraday hour count can be stated beyond that.
69afccbb5aeb6283f4dde564.makes_money_when: Best: bear trend, avg +25.92 pts (win_rate 56.52%, 23 trades); high realized vol, avg +35.21 pts (win_rate 51.85%, 27 trades). Worst: sideways markets, avg -2.17 pts (win_rate 27.59%, 29 trades); normal realized vol, avg -2.54 pts (win_rate 28.57%, 28 trades).
69afccbb5aeb6283f4dde564.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol): the strategy is flat-to-losing in low realized vol (avg -0.42 pts) and normal realized vol (avg -2.54 pts), but jumps to avg +35.21 pts in high realized vol — it needs actual price movement to pay off, consistent with being a directional option-buying strategy rather than a premium-selling one.

69c3702d12ed76b963d4db84.name: Catalyst Partial Target
69c3702d12ed76b963d4db84.summary: Catalyst Partial Target is a NIFTY option-buying strategy that scales out at partial profit targets rather than riding to expiry. Across 40 tagged trades it wins only 42.5% of the time but nets positive (profit factor 1.67; avg win +35.5 pts vs avg loss -15.7 pts), with its edge concentrated in falling and high-volatility markets (bear +28.55 pts, 66.7% win; high-vol +16.67 pts, 53.3% win) while it bleeds in sideways, normal-vol chop (-7.42 pts, 23.8% win; -5.4 pts, 29.4% win).
69c3702d12ed76b963d4db84.what_it_trades: NIFTY option-buying (long calls/puts), 'partial_target' exit style — 40 trades in the tagged sample; side split (CE vs PE) and moneyness aren't recorded in the facts file.
69c3702d12ed76b963d4db84.style_evidence: Regime.dir: sideways avg -7.42 pts (23.8% win, 21 trades) vs bear avg +28.55 pts (66.7% win, 12 trades) and bull avg +8.07 pts (57.1% win, 7 trades). Regime.vol: normal avg -5.4 pts (29.4% win) vs high avg +16.67 pts (53.3% win). Profit and win rate both concentrate in trending/directional and elevated-vol conditions, not range-bound ones, so this reads as directional/momentum rather than premium-selling.
69c3702d12ed76b963d4db84.expiry: (inferred) NIFTY weekly options — category is option_buying on underlying NIFTY, but no explicit expiry field is present in the facts file, so this is a soft inference only.
69c3702d12ed76b963d4db84.hold: Style label is 'partial_target', meaning it scales out of winners at a target rather than holding the full position to expiry. Data is date-level only, so no specific intraday hold duration can be stated beyond that partial-exit behavior.
69c3702d12ed76b963d4db84.makes_money_when: Best: bear trend, avg +28.55 pts, 66.7% win (12 trades); also strong in high realized vol, avg +16.67 pts, 53.3% win (15 trades). Worst: sideways trend, avg -7.42 pts, 23.8% win (21 trades); also weak in normal/medium realized vol, avg -5.4 pts, 29.4% win (17 trades).
69c3702d12ed76b963d4db84.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data is available; using the realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol), the strategy does best in high-realized-vol regimes (+16.67 pts avg, 53.3% win) and holds up in low-vol (+10.62 pts avg, 50% win), but loses money in normal/medium realized vol (-5.4 pts avg, 29.4% win) — it appears to need either big moves or calm trend, and struggles in mid-range choppiness.

698075e9f867bf12b20442e3.name: Ratio-Weave Credit Spread Expiry
698075e9f867bf12b20442e3.summary: A weekly-expiry NIFTY vertical credit spread strategy, roughly split CE/PE (50.8%/49.2%), held through expiry week. It wins less often than it loses (46% win rate) but wins bigger (avg +83.2 pts vs -58.1 pts), giving a 1.22 profit factor across ~7.9 trades/month. Edge shows up in trending markets (bull, bear) and calmer realized-vol conditions; it bleeds in sideways markets.
698075e9f867bf12b20442e3.what_it_trades: ~400-pt-wide NIFTY vertical credit spreads (2-leg, 0% iron condors), ~51% CE / ~49% PE, avg entry credit ~112.6 pts, ~7.9 trades/month, held through expiry week.
698075e9f867bf12b20442e3.style_evidence: Directional axis favors trend: bull avg +25.64 pts (58.3% win, 12 trades) and bear avg +12.0 pts (50% win, 22 trades) vs sideways avg -4.65 pts (37.9% win, 29 trades) — a momentum signature. But the vol axis favors calm markets: low-vol avg +16.17 pts (50% win) beats normal +8.23 pts and high-vol +4.44 pts — a mean-revert signature. The two axes point opposite ways, so the style reads as mixed rather than purely one or the other.
698075e9f867bf12b20442e3.hold: Held through expiry week (per style_label) — data is date-level only, no intraday hold duration available.
698075e9f867bf12b20442e3.makes_money_when: Best: bull trend, avg +25.64 pts/trade (58.3% win, 12 trades) and low realized-vol, avg +16.17 pts/trade (50% win, 6 trades). Worst: sideways markets, avg -4.65 pts/trade (37.9% win, 29 trades — its most common regime).
698075e9f867bf12b20442e3.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using realized-vol buckets as a proxy, avg_pts declines as realized vol rises: low-vol +16.17 pts (50% win) > normal-vol +8.23 pts (43.5% win) > high-vol +4.44 pts (47.1% win). Performance is best in calm realized-vol conditions and weakens, though stays slightly positive, as realized vol increases.

692581dc0397e05e57273de1.name: Vega-Shift Credit Spread Expiry
692581dc0397e05e57273de1.summary: Vega-Shift Credit Spread Expiry sells ~400-point NIFTY vertical credit spreads (55% put-side, 45% call-side), entering at ~101.7 pts avg credit and holding through weekly expiry. Across 125 trades it's close to a coin flip overall (50.4% win rate, profit factor 1.17, avg win 59.2 pts vs avg loss -51.3 pts), with no strong directional bias — bear weeks (+6.76 avg pts) edge out bull weeks (+2.24 avg pts) only slightly. Its real edge is in the realized-vol regime: normal-vol weeks are strongly profitable (+23.12 avg pts, 64.5% win) while low-vol weeks actually lose money (-6.82 avg pts), matching its 'Vega-Shift' name.
692581dc0397e05e57273de1.what_it_trades: ~400-pt NIFTY vertical credit spreads (2-leg, no iron condors), 55% put-side / 45% call-side, ~101.7-pt avg entry credit, ~13.9 trades/month
692581dc0397e05e57273de1.style_evidence: Directional buckets show only a weak skew (bear avg +6.76 pts / 51.2% win, n=41 vs sideways +3.62 pts / 52.4% win, n=63 vs bull +2.24 pts / 42.9% win, n=21 — bear tops it but bull stays positive too, ruling out a clean bull&bear momentum read). Vol buckets swing far more: normal-vol +23.12 pts / 64.5% win (n=31) vs low-vol -6.82 pts / 44.0% win (n=25) vs high-vol +0.09 pts / 46.4% win (n=69). Since profit isn't concentrated in sideways+low-vol (premium-selling) or in bull&bear+high-vol (momentum), and side mix is 55/45 without iron condors, it lands as mixed.
692581dc0397e05e57273de1.hold: Held through expiry week per style_label ('Weekly expiry — hold spread through expiry week'); data is date-level only, no intraday/hour granularity available
692581dc0397e05e57273de1.makes_money_when: Best: bear-trending weeks (avg +6.76 pts, 51.2% win, n=41) and normal realized-vol weeks (avg +23.12 pts, 64.5% win, n=31). Worst: low realized-vol weeks (avg -6.82 pts, 44.0% win, n=25) and bull-trending weeks (weakest bucket at avg +2.24 pts, 42.9% win, n=21).
692581dc0397e05e57273de1.iv_sensitivity: No implied-vol data exists; using realized-vol buckets as a proxy (not implied vol), the strategy is sharply regime-dependent: normal realized vol is its best environment (+23.12 avg pts, 64.5% win, n=31), low realized vol is a net loser (-6.82 avg pts, 44.0% win, n=25), and high realized vol is roughly flat (+0.09 avg pts, 46.4% win, n=69).

6769bf2b0d4e963ea3effa0a.name: Index Scalper
6769bf2b0d4e963ea3effa0a.summary: Index Scalper is a trend-following NIFTY options scalper trading ITM calls/puts in near-even mix (49% CE / 51% PE), firing ~22 trades/month (~1/day). Win rate is modest at 45.9% but a 1.44 profit factor comes from letting winners run (avg +43.9 pts) against smaller controlled losses (avg -25.9 pts). It works best on trending bull or bear days and in higher realized vol, and is weakest in sideways, low-vol chop.
6769bf2b0d4e963ea3effa0a.what_it_trades: ~1 trade/day of ITM NIFTY index options (calls and puts near-evenly split, 49%/51%), entered on proprietary trend-following signals, ~22 trades/month across 482 total trades.
6769bf2b0d4e963ea3effa0a.style_evidence: Bull days avg +12.75 pts (WR 49.0%) and bear days avg +9.75 pts (WR 49.0%) both beat sideways days' avg +2.25 pts (WR 43.4%); high-vol avg +8.42 pts and normal-vol avg +7.49 pts both beat low-vol avg +2.59 pts. Directional days and higher vol pay more than flat/quiet days, matching the file's own ob_strategy trend_label 'trend_following' and market_fit 'bull_day_alpha'.
6769bf2b0d4e963ea3effa0a.expiry: Not stated in the facts file — there is no expiry/tenor data (weekly vs. monthly) in the source; only ITM moneyness and a ~1 trade/day cadence are given, so expiry cycle cannot be determined from this data.
6769bf2b0d4e963ea3effa0a.hold: intraday scalp — per the one_liner ('fast scalping on index moves') positions are opened and closed within the day, not carried to expiry; the facts file is date-level only so no specific hour count is stated.
6769bf2b0d4e963ea3effa0a.makes_money_when: Best: bull trend days, avg +12.75 pts (WR 49.0%, n=104). Also strong: bear trend days, avg +9.75 pts (WR 49.0%, n=104). Worst: sideways/range days, avg +2.25 pts (WR 43.4%, n=274) — still positive but far weaker.
